name: Instantly
shortDescription: Cold email outreach. The Growth plan is listed at $47 per month.
longDescription: Instantly's pricing page lists outreach plans, including a Growth plan at $47 per month with unlimited email accounts, and it describes an AI Sales Agent. A higher starter bundle was also listed. We did not create an account.
pricingNotes: Pricing page lists an Outreach Growth plan at $47 per month and an AI Sales Agent.
bestFor: Sending sales email sequences from more than one inbox
notIdealFor: A team that only needs a CRM and not outbound email
strength: Instantly lists an Outreach Growth plan at $47 per month and describes an AI Sales Agent.
weakness: Higher bundles on the same page cost more, and the fetched text did not promise a free ongoing plan.
smokeTestNotes: Official page checked on 2026-10-19. No account, payment, or hands-on run.

useCaseFit.sales-outreach: Lists sales email outreach from $47 per month and an AI sales agent.
